rows.quote: The data from UK Biobank was obtained from the UK Biobank Resource under application numbers 42,468 and 45,052.
rows.dataset_named_in_source: UK Biobank Resource under application numbers 42,468 and 45,052
rows.coder_note: Step 3 (rule C): the UK Biobank outcome data are the authors' own analysis of individual-level data, defined by application numbers (42,468 and 45,052), a phenotype definition (IHD cases from record linkage to hospitalization and death records and a nurse-led interview, p034) and described procedures (SNP associations with IHD in men, own GWAS with REGENIE, p029-p030). For adjudication: for total cholesterol, fasting glucose and LDL-cholesterol p032 uses Neale Lab summary statistics in men (https://www.nealelab.is/uk-biobank); that address is shared by the two Neale lab rows and no round is stated, so it identifies neither and steps 1 and 2 do not apply. Reference 52 (Mahajan 2018) is the DIAGRAM diabetes source, not this row.
